title: Tutorial
about:
Made for [Game Jam] by [Team].

intro.note: FEATURE: cutscene. Slides play by themselves and crossfade. Click skips.
FEATURE: chapter title card. Also starts new music (any step can change music).

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: Welcome! This is a text step. Click, Space or Enter to continue.

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: The background and music stay until a step changes them. The stats (top-left) come from 'stats' in story.json.

intro.speaker: Alice
intro.note: FEATURE: sprite positions left / middle / right.

intro.speaker: Alice
intro.text: Same position, different image = new expression.

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: Setting a position to null removes that sprite. Bye goat.

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: *ding* That was a sound effect. It plays once when the step starts.
No 'speaker' means narration: no name is shown.

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: This background file doesn't exist, so you get a grey placeholder with its name instead of a crash. Check the console for the warning.

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: Next is a choice. Each option changes stats. If a stat goes below 0 you instantly jump to its scene in 'lose'.

intro.note: FEATURE: choice. 'text' is an optional prompt. 'flag' is optional and remembers the pick.
FEATURE: a branch with only 'else' is a plain jump to another scene.

year7.speaker: Alice
year7.text: Spa day. What could go wrong?

year7.note: Any step can carry bg / sprites / music / sfx, including choices.

options.text: Tackle it away from the bonfire
Let it leap into the flames

year7.note: FEATURE: branch. Rules are checked top to bottom, first match wins, otherwise 'else'.

rules.note: every listed flag must be set
stat rule example (never true here). Use min, max or both.

goat_death.speaker: Goat
goat_death.text: You ran out of time. The goat did something stupid.

goat_death.text:

The goat got you.
